sources.title: A New Open Space System for Eastern Cambridge and Kendall Square
sources.publisher: City of Cambridge Community Development Department
sources.license: citation only; page copyright retained by publisher
sources.intended_use: Compare a connected public-space network and open community planning process.
sources.limitations: Supports Kendall Square mechanism comparison only; does not prove Jingzhang conditions, causality or long-term inclusion outcomes.

sources.title: Cortex Strategic Plan
sources.license: citation only; page copyright retained by publisher
sources.intended_use: Compare a welcoming innovation district, talent ladder and stated inclusion goals.
sources.limitations: Targets and impact figures are operator-reported; they are not transferred as Jingzhang forecasts or causal evidence.

sources.title: King's Cross Estate Management
sources.license: citation only; all rights reserved by publisher
sources.intended_use: Compare visible human assistance, estate operations and explicit facial-recognition policy.
sources.limitations: Privately managed accessible space is not equivalent to statutory public space; current policy is not evidence of historic or universal digital-rights compliance.

sources.title: Quayside
sources.license: citation only; municipal page copyright retained
sources.intended_use: Compare scope resetting, transparent procurement, independent fairness monitoring and public-benefit housing governance.
sources.limitations: The current Quayside project is distinct from the discontinued Sidewalk Labs proposal; neither provides Jingzhang planning controls or delivery commitments.

sources.title: Innovation
sources.license: citation only; page copyright retained by publisher
sources.intended_use: Compare a large-scale urban living laboratory, open innovation network and public-space experimentation.
sources.limitations: Operator descriptions and French national-development conditions are not transferable as Jingzhang performance, scale or investment evidence.

sources.title: FLEX Bus - Driverless Shuttle
sources.license: citation only; university page copyright retained
sources.intended_use: Compare a completed public-road autonomous trial with free access, accessibility, onboard chaperone, emergency stop and manual takeover.
sources.limitations: A completed Australian trial does not establish Beijing road approval, insurance, refusal rights, safety thresholds or operational feasibility.

sources.title: Science and Innovation
sources.license: citation only; municipal page copyright retained
sources.intended_use: Compare the 22@ innovation hub, knowledge-transfer infrastructure and city-scale science network.
sources.limitations: Barcelona governance, land-use conversion and investment conditions are not transferable as Jingzhang approvals, effects or commitments.

sources.title: Get to know AI Register
sources.license: citation only; municipal page copyright retained
sources.intended_use: Compare public disclosure and feedback fields for municipal AI systems.
sources.limitations: A public register supports transparency but does not by itself prove accessibility, accountability, legal remedy or local suitability.

sources.title: How Is the STATION F Campus Organized?
sources.license: citation only; page copyright retained by publisher
sources.intended_use: Compare shared resources, selective startup space and public/semi-public campus zones as an ecosystem-support mechanism.
sources.limitations: A selective private startup campus is not a model for universal public access and is used only as a professional-support reference.
